identitySignals: Name matches 'Piedmont Parlor No. 120', listed as a local parlor (chapter) in the official Native Sons of the Golden West directory at nsgw.org/parlors

Search results (not fetched directly) link members of Piedmont Parlor #120 to a World War I 'Boys of North Oakland' monument on San Pablo Avenue in front of an Aspire school, matching the agenda item about transferring possession of a World War I memorial to Aspire Public Schools
research.notes: Local parlor of a larger statewide fraternal organization (NSGW, headquartered at 414 Mason St, Suite 300, San Francisco). The parlor has no website, registry ID or general contact of its own on any page I could cite; the only contact in search snippets is a named individual, which is out of scope. The link to the OUSD memorial rests on search-result text that I could not confirm by fetching the source page (the newsletter PDF would not parse). Not recommended for publication.

profile.summary: Piedmont Parlor No. 120 is a local chapter (called a parlor) of the Native Sons of the Golden West, a California fraternal and charitable organization that works to preserve the history of California and does community service. The parlor meets monthly at the Veterans' Memorial Building in San Leandro.
